report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry contradicts the alert: traces show a single OK checkout span at 69ms, metrics show error_rate 0.0012, p95 70ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters, and logs show a 200 request_complete. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause; downstream services (order, inventory, payment, postgresql, redis) have no observations. Handing off for downstream telemetry.
